title: Too small for most uses
text:
Too small for most uses. I have to say that this item is fairly useless.

It is a VERY small plastic spatula dipped in silicone. It won't scratch your pans. The size makes it fairly impractical, unless you are making one egg, or have a really tiny skillet.

I cannot recommend this one.
